entry.title: RT Kaizen D. Asiedu: A note on affirmative action: In a competitive system where one person getting a spot means that another person doesn’t, if dive...
entry.summary: RT Kaizen D. Asiedu A note on affirmative action: In a competitive system where one person getting a spot means that another person doesn’t, if diversity is the goal (rather than a means to an end), then achieving that goal comes at the expense of pure merit. I suspect most beneficiaries of affirmative action are qualified in the sense that they still clear a reasonable minimum bar. But one can clear a minimum bar while still being relatively less qualified than other people who also cleared that minimum bar. You can be qualified and still not be the best. Affirmative action does not select for the most qualified applicants. This is not a statement about what ought to be, but what is the case.
